proof_scope: Tau durable operator action inbox, idempotency, cross-process application, and uncertain-claim reconciliation

claims.proves: Tau can persist bounded operator actions in the SQLite run store, reject idempotency conflicts, apply an action exactly once through the scheduler-owned claim/complete path after reopening the store, and reconcile a claimed action left without a terminal receipt after process restart.
claims.does_not_prove: Human acceptance, external UI delivery, provider semantic quality, or that every operator action subtype is semantically applied by a live runtime backend.

capability_claims.description: Tau stores bounded operator actions durably, preserves idempotency, applies actions only through scheduler-owned claim/complete transitions, and reconciles uncertain claimed actions after process restart.

cases.name: operator-action-inbox-sqlite-cross-process-apply-once
command: cd .. && mkdir -p local/agentic-evals && TAU_OPERATOR_ACTION_INBOX_PROOF=local/agentic-evals/tau-operator-action-inbox-proof.json uv run pytest --tau-suite=all tests/test_operator_action_inbox.py::test_operator_action_request_survives_process_reopen_and_applies_once tests/test_operator_action_inbox.py::test_operator_action_inbox_can_emit_machine_readable_proof -q -s
